images.title: Group, count, compare
images.purpose: Show the method for reading a mixed list: group the answers by choice, then count each group.
images.composition: A mixed row on the left, an arrow in the middle, three neat groups on the right, all with wide space.
images.exact_structure: Left: one row of exactly 12 equal circles in mixed order, 4 teal #0072B2, 4 amber #E69F00, 4 reddish purple #CC79A7, colours scattered. Middle: one grey #6B7280 arrow. Right: 3 separate rows of 4 equal circles each, one row per colour, stacked with wide gaps. Exactly 12 circles on each side.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a different number of circles on the left and the right
any bar chart, table or count digits
images.takeaway: Group the answers by choice, then count each group.
images.description: A mixed row of 12 coloured circles, an arrow, and the same circles sorted into 3 rows of 4, one row per colour.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say what changed between the mixed row and the three groups.

image_decisions.why: Grouping a mixed list is a picture idea; one image carries it.
